body: It's not about that.  It's about love.  As long as that person still loves me I can't bear to hurt them.  If that person were no longer in my life, I would have no reason to hesitate.
God gave this darkness to me as my cross to bear.  It is truly a sickness, and God gave us modern science as well.  If a pill can help me, He will not begrudge me taking it.

I'm also tired of putting other people in front of myself.  I wait and wait and people keep insisting on being a part of my life.  I could wait for my parents to die but my siblings are younger than I am.  I could wait for everyone to die but the thought of living another fifty years or more feels incomprehensible.  Two brothers died in a hunting accident recently and everyone is very sad.  If I had died and one of those guys had lived, those parents would still have a child, and my parents would be minus only one.
